title: Use alternate plotting sequence
desc: If ON, will select the Plot Route icon on the right hand side of the Galaxy Map, instead of pressing UI Select when focussed on the system on the map. This is a workaround for users who experience the bug in Galaxy Map where they cannot select the system

title: Close EDCoPilot on clean shutdown of Elite Dangerous
desc: If on, will automatically shut down when you exit to desktop from Elite Dangerous menu.

title: Close EDCoPilot if Elite Dangerous not detected for X minutes
desc: Set this value to number of minutes Elite Dangerous isnt running before EDCoPilot closes automatically. Set to 0 to ignore.

title: Automatic Updates
desc: If on, will automatically download and apply updates. If off, will require manual intervention.

title: Call Voice Attack
desc: If ON, will trigger a reload in Voice Attack of its dynamic variables, so it can recognise new phrases like recent system names plotted to, or new bookmark group names. If OFF, these will not be recognisable until next Voice Attack restart or executing voice command 'Refresh CoPilot'

title: Default Voice Attack listening state
desc: If ON, VA listening will be resumed after loading the EDCoPilot profile, or when dynamic variables are updated. If OFF, VA listening will be stopped.

title: Automatically bookmark your destination system
desc: If on, will add your destination to your bookmarks list

title: Auto deploy on-foot shields
desc: If on, will deploy your shield when you deploy a weapon or come under attack.

title: Auto-disable on-foot shield when you holster your weapon
desc: If on, will disable your shield when you holster your weapon.

title: Delay when dropping shields after holstering (seconds)
desc: If Auto-disable is ON above, then this setting represents how many seconds to wait before the shield is disabled, after you holster your weapon. Re-drawing a weapon during this interval will cause the scheduled disable to be ignored.

title: Ignore disable shield on holster if at a CZ
desc: If on, will ignore the auto-disable of on-foot shield when you holster weapon at a CZ.

title: Discovery Mode ('AutoHonk') - NOTE: this uses the Primary or Secondary fire of the active firegroup, NOT the DSS scan keybind (which is only active when in FSS mode)
Enable / disable Discovery Mode
desc: If on (and your primary or secondary weapon keybinds are set), will activate the Discovery Scanner when you enter a system

title: Discovery Scanner mapped to Primary or Secondary fire button
desc: Select which fire button you have mapped the Discovery Scanner to in your firegroup

title: Auto Neutron plotter on/off (note, there is also a button on the Neutron Highway bookmark group panel for this)
desc: If on and you are following a plotted Neutron Highway route, will automatically plot to the next neutron star once you supercharge your FSD at the current neutron star

title: Auto Neutron - plotting delay after supercharging (seconds)
desc: Set the number of seconds (5 - 20) you want to allow you to exit the cone after supercharging, before EDCoPilot plots to the next neutron star in the route

title: Auto Neutorn - Plot vs Target
desc: Whether to Plot to the next system or just Target the next system, when Auto Neutron sets course for next Neutron waypoint

title: FSD repair reminder after x supercharges
desc: Set the number of supercharges you wish to execute before EDCoPilot reminds you to repair your FSD. Set to 0 if you do not want a reminder.

title: Auto-Target Highest Threat
desc: If on, will issue the 'Target Highest Threat' command every few seconds when ship is under attack

title: Trigger Instant Replay on death (requires Geforce Instant Replay)
desc: If on, trigger the Instant Replay capture to save the last x minutes of gameplay when your ship is destroyed
